summary: A compact one-page specimen for a free, pay-what-you-want friendly sans in five weights: alternating charcoal and white bands, one yellow accent, and a fixed yellow Download button. Its special moves are hidden overlays: a 'Try Now: Type something!' sticker leads to a full-screen tester, and Download opens a Stripe pay-what-you-want modal.

instances.look: Charcoal screen with a small ruled 'AFFOGATO' title above five white capital A's stepping from Black to Light, a one-line descriptor below
instances.ux: The A's fade in one after another on load (seen at t≈0.3s in the video); a fixed yellow Download button sits top-right and a tilted yellow 'Try Now' sticker pokes up from the bottom-left
instances.learn: One letter repeated across all weights is a wordmark-free hero: it shows the family's range in a single glance, and needs no sample copy

reconstruction.layout: Full-bleed ~95vh (852px) dark band; centred column 800px wide: title with 280px hairlines on both sides at y≈225; row of 5 A's at y≈350–470, about 180px apart; caption centred at y≈700; Download button fixed top 45px, right 72px, 174×46px
reconstruction.typography: Title 36px Affogato Bold caps, tracked ~0.1em, white; A's 160px Black, Bold, Medium, Regular, Light; caption 24px Bold white; 'Designed by' 18px Regular with the name link in yellow; button 20px Regular caps, dark on yellow
reconstruction.behaviour: Staggered fade-in of the A's left to right on load, finished within ~1s; nothing else moves
reconstruction.content: 'A friendly sans-serif typeface. Designed by Eric Lobdell'

instances.look: Never captured open: hidden section#type-tester holds one centred 200px text input and a row of five 80px A's labelled Black, Bold, Medium, Regular, Light as the weight picker; only its tilted yellow 'Try Now: Type something!' sticker is visible, at the bottom-left of the hero
instances.ux: The sticker invites typing with no field in sight. The input has autofocus and a close × button; the trigger itself is in the unarchived script.js, so opening on a keypress is inferred from the wording. Clicking an A swaps the weight class on the input
instances.learn: Ask visitors to type before they see any field: a small sticker turns the whole page into a tester, and letter buttons in each weight replace a slider for a static family

reconstruction.layout: Full-screen overlay inferred from the hidden section; single-line input centred at 200px text size; picker row of five A's beneath; × at a corner; sticker is ~230×40px, rotated about −5°, overlapping the band edge at left ~115px
reconstruction.typography: Input 200px Affogato Black by default, centred; picker A's 80px each in its own weight with a 20px Regular label; sticker 16px Bold 'Try Now:' + Medium, dark on yellow
reconstruction.behaviour: Weight picker: click li[data-change-weight] → replace the weight class on .test-input and move .active-weight (HTML comments say the selected weight gets a yellow class); close with .overlay-close
reconstruction.content: Empty field; the visitor's own text
reconstruction.html: section#type-tester.hidden > button.overlay-close + input.test-input[autofocus] + .weight-selector > ul.test-weights > li[data-change-weight=black|bold|medium|regular|light] > label; sticker is .hint in #intro

instances.look: Modal, captured in HTML only: 'PAY WHAT YOU WANT / Fonts are hard to make, you know.', an e-mail field, five price chips ($50, $25, $10, $5, Free) and a submit button. Its fixed yellow Download trigger appears on every screen and repeats across the stitched capture (attached here to the hero block)
instances.ux: Fixed Download button opens the modal. Choosing a paid amount reveals the Stripe card fields and 'Donate & Download'; Free keeps the plain 'Download Now'. Terms of Use link, tooltip explaining e-mail use
instances.learn: Put the free option in the same row as the paid amounts and reveal card fields only after a paid choice: the ask stays light and Free stays honest

reconstruction.layout: Centred modal with a coloured accent strip on top, close × at the corner; stacked: header, e-mail, 5 equal radio chips in a row, conditional #pay block (name, card number, CVC, expiry, zip) or #free block, legal notice
reconstruction.typography: Title 32px Affogato Bold caps; subline 16px Regular; fields 20px Regular centred; chips 16px Medium; button 20px Regular caps; notice 14px Regular
reconstruction.behaviour: Radio change toggles #pay and #free; each chip has two stacked spans, likely a hover or selected state swap; Stripe Elements card form posts to download.php; errors show in .payment-errors and .choice-errors
reconstruction.content: Amounts $50, $25, $10, $5, Free; 'Used only for a major Affogato update'; 'Payments via Stripe'

instances.look: 'GLYPHS' in big Light caps above the whole character set in Light as one centred, wide-spaced paragraph on white
instances.learn: A single paragraph of space-separated glyphs reads like a grid at almost no cost: no cells, no script, and it reflows on mobile by itself

reconstruction.layout: ~1255px tall white band; heading centred; paragraph ~1000px wide from x≈215, 13 lines at ~64px line height, glyphs separated by spaces and letter-spacing, justified-looking to about the same width
reconstruction.typography: Heading 80px Affogato Light caps; glyphs 36px Light, dark grey
reconstruction.content: A–Z, accented capitals, a–z, accented lowercase, punctuation, currency, numerals, maths, symbols
reconstruction.html: section#glyphs p.all-glyphs.light.s36 with each glyph separated by a space

instances.look: The letters P R D B A in Black over the same row in Light, with a tilted yellow highlighter stripe running through the Black row along the slant of their tops
instances.learn: One coloured stripe along a shared angle explains a design trait across letters with no words: the slanted apexes the text below mentions

instances.learn: Use the real 'about' text as the sample for every style, so the comparison paragraph also does the job of the intro copy

instances.look: Five capital Q's in a row, Black to Light, with no caption, spotlighting the characteristic tail. Not annotated in the strict sense; the paragraph above names Q as a signature glyph
instances.learn: After text naming a signature glyph, set that glyph alone across all weights as a visual full stop
